# T-3: Defer gate exhaustion

## Goal
Route gate retry exhaustion with only AI-derived content/alignment findings into flow findings while preserving mechanical blocker failures.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Semantic gate exhaustion advances traversal and records source gate findings.
- Every retry-then-defer gate phase has a durable bounded source artifact before flow-findings references it.
- Missing artifact, invalid schema, failed test evidence, no-progress guard, and tooling failure still block.

## Implementation Notes
Apply to tracked gate phases. Persist bounded gate source artifacts for phases that currently only return envelopes. Keep existing gate artifacts, retry metrics, and issue-log entries.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests under specs/293-bounded-defer-review/tests/ with // spec: R3/R8 headers cover content/alignment defer, durable gate source artifacts, retry metric retention, issue-log retention, and each mechanical blocker preservation path.
